Subject: Request: LLM training, storage & transfer controls (DPIA inputs)

Hi Stephanie,

I manage data protection for GlobHealth. As part of a DPIA we're preparing for an upcoming pilot that will send de-identified patient Q&A to your hosted inference API, our legal team asked me to collect a short set of confirmations and evidence from Redwood so we can complete our assessment. We need these items within 3 business days if possible: 

- Clear confirmation whether Redwood (hosted API) uses customer prompts/responses to train or update model weights. If yes, how is consent handled and can we opt-out?
- Details on prompt/response logging (what's captured, retention default, how to request deletion).
- Evidence of cross-border transfer controls (SCCs, transfer maps) for EU->US processing.
- A short attestation we can put in our DPIA stating that customer content will not be used to improve public models (or the alternative if it is).
- SIG/CAIQ or SOC2 snippets that map to data processing & access controls (if you can provide a short pack or pointers).
- A redacted sample of access or audit logs showing who accessed request payloads (suitable for review).

Can you also confirm whether Dedicated or on-prem deployments differ on these points?

Thanks — if you prefer, you can send the material via a secure share link rather than attachments.

Regards,
Sigrid Olsen
DPO, GlobHealth

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Thanks Stephanie — below are concise answers and pointers we can share with the customer. I'm attaching the items to the internal evidence folder and will export the signed attestation and a redacted sample log for Stephanie to send.

1) Training on customer data
- Redwood does NOT use customer prompts/responses from the Hosted API to train or update our public foundation models by default. We treat customer content as customer data and it is not ingested into our model-development pipelines.
- For Dedicated/on-prem customers, we provide an explicit option under contract to enable fine-tuning or private model training using customer-provided datasets or exported logs; this is a separate, opt-in service and is never enabled without a signed agreement.

2) Opt-out / deletion
- Hosted API customers can opt-out of any optional training or analytics features via account settings and contractual terms.
- Data deletion requests are handled through our support flow (support@redwood.com) and we provide deletion confirmation and a deletion audit (timestamp + operator id). For Hosted API default retention, request/response payloads are encrypted and retained for 14 days for observability and debugging, unless a customer requests shorter retention or zero retention on their account. Dedicated deployments follow the customer's retention policy by configuration.

3) Prompt/response logging
- What we log: request id, timestamp, model variant, token counts, latency, customer-provided request metadata. By default we store full request/response payloads for the 14-day window stated above. Logs are encrypted at rest (AWS KMS) and access is limited via role-based controls and audited.

4) Cross-border transfers & SCCs
- We have an EU transfer map and execute SCCs (European Commission standard contractual clauses) for relevant customer relationships. Attached is our latest SCC transfer map (scc_transfer_map_v2.pdf). We can provide signed SCC amendments upon request.

5) Evidence and questionnaires
- SOC 2: We can provide SOC2 report excerpts relevant to availability/access controls upon NDA.
- SIG/CAIQ: We maintain a CAIQ pack; rather than sending the full SIG, we typically provide a one-page mapping for quick review and a secure CAIQ export if needed.

6) Audit logs / sample
- Attached is a redacted sample access log (sample_access_log_redacted.csv) showing timestamped access events and RBAC actor IDs. Sensitive identifiers have been redacted.

7) KMS / keys
- Customer data in transit TLS 1.2+; at rest encrypted via customer or Redwood-managed KMS. For Private / Dedicated customers on VPC, we support customer-provided CMKs (HSM-backed) where required.

Suggested attachments for the customer: redwood_attestation_no_train_signed.pdf, sample_access_log_redacted.csv, scc_transfer_map_v2.pdf, and a secure evidence folder link.

If you want, I'll pre-sign the attestation and place it in the secure folder.

-Markus
Head of Security & Compliance

- Deletion evidence: we provide deletion confirmations and can produce deletion audit records per request.
- Transfers: we execute SCCs and maintain an EU->US transfer map (attached).
